name: synonym-candidates
description:
Synonym candidates for the units of the core, from a thesaurus (RuWordNet) and word vectors (navec).

A candidate is a proposal for the Human to pick, not a synonym: the thesaurus gives the words and phrases of the same synset (score 1), the word vectors the nearest words (the score is the cosine, 4 places). A unit is a word of a phrase of the core, or a run of its words that is a sense of several words of the thesaurus («таможенное оформление»): of all the ways to cut a phrase into runs, the one with the most words inside such senses wins, then the one with fewer units, then the first from the left. A word inside a run has no candidates of its own. A stopword is no unit by itself, and so is a word with digits. The step works on lemmas; a candidate of the thesaurus has any number of words, a candidate of the vectors is one word, and each is given once for a unit. The report has one row for each candidate: word (the unit), candidate, source, score and in_core (whether the candidate is a run of words of a phrase of the core), units in the order of the core, each with the candidates of the thesaurus first, then of the vectors from the nearest.
top: how many of the nearest words the word vectors give for each word.
all: give every candidate. By default only the candidates that occur in the core.
as_synonyms: the report as the file the steps with `--synonyms` read: the columns word and synonyms (the candidates of a word joined by a space), one row for each word that has some. The steps compare word by word, so it holds the candidates of one word of the units of one word only.
as_slots: the report as the table of slots that `linear-combinations` reads: a column slot_1, slot_2… for each unit of the one phrase of the core, in its order; the first row holds the units, the rows under them their candidates. More than one phrase, or together with as_synonyms, is refused.

Example: semkit read --text "растаможка" --text "таможенное оформление" synonym-candidates --source ruwordnet write -
-> растаможка, таможенное оформление, ruwordnet, 1.0, true; таможенное оформление, растаможка, ruwordnet, 1.0, true

source: the data to take candidates from, pulled once with `semkit models pull NAME`: ruwordnet (the thesaurus), navec (the word vectors) or both.

The step makes a table of its result; it replaces the current table, its first text column is the working one. Its candidates are for the Human to pick; the picked go to --synonyms of the steps that take them. A candidate may have several words, and so may a unit; --as-synonyms keeps the words of one word only.
